title: pasania elaeagnifolia
intro: Pasania elaeagnifolia, commonly known as the Pasania tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as aiding in the treatment of digestive problems and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pasania elaeagnifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
